payload.title: Feeding cost is computed from the feed's own price currency but stamped with the tenant default currency, and the summary labels every total NOK and adds mixed currencies together
payload.rule_violated: A monetary amount carries the currency it was computed in, and an aggregate is per currency, never a literal default
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Live: finance_settings.defaultCurrency TRY, feeds priced in TRY, feeding_records.currency USD on all 7 rows; the card shows 'Total Cost 12012 NOK'. Fix: store the price currency with the cost, return currency and per-currency totals from feedingSummary, drop the literal NOK.
